title: Sales 'education' is broken. We're teaching reps *what* to say, not *how to rewire* their GTM behavior. That's why 'vibes' run your pipeline. 🧵
caption: Sales 'education' is failing us. We teach reps *what* to say, not *how to rewire* GTM behavior. That's why pipeline forecasts in EdTech rely on 'vibes,' not data. Time to fix the curriculum. 🧵
